page.layout: Running head at top, centred left: "Roma Irreconciliabilis." with page number 71 at top right. One column of text in the centre, from top to bottom. Notes in the right margin beside the column's lower half. Signature "F 4" and a printer's mark at the foot.

main_text.l: cem, O nimium beatum, si iustitia quæ iam non nisi in cœlis creditur, apud te solum inueniatur in terris. Sat nobis interea est defectus nostros deflere, odisse iniustitiam: Vera Donatistarum vox est, Non habeo quod ignoscas: Claudet nunc scenam hanc Bernardus: Non peccare Dei iustitia est: Hominis vero iustitia, indulgentia Dei: Imputare ergo & inhærere non minus distant, quàm ab homine Deus, à cœlo Tridentum: Quocirca fateantur illi demùm quod Scriptura, quod Patres, quod modestiores suæ Ecclesiæ doctores & senserunt,

marginalia.note: Optat.l.2.contr. Donat. Ser. in Cant. & Serm.4. de ver. Efa. Reclam forsitan iustitiam, sed non puram, &c.

page.notes: The right-margin note is set in small italic and is partly worn; "Optat.l.2.contr." and "Reclam" are doubtful readings. The printed signature "F 4" is at the foot, followed by a printer's mark that is not transcribed. Show-through from the reverse ("SECT") at the lower left is left out.
